seo.title: Best Jazz Bars in Casablanca (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Explore Casablanca's top jazz bars and lounges for an unforgettable night out. From iconic piano bars to chic rooftop spots, discover where to find the best live music, cocktails, and ambiance in Morocco's vibrant city. Perfect for music lovers and nightlife explorers.

hero.subtitle: Casablanca's nightlife hums with an unexpected rhythm, offering a selection of sophisticated jazz bars and live music venues that blend Moroccan charm with timeless melodies. Discover an evening of smooth tunes, exquisite cocktails, and vibrant atmospheres.

picks.name: Rick's Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Step into the cinematic magic of Rick's Cafe, an homage to the classic film 'Casablanca.' This beautifully recreated bar offers daily live piano music, often featuring jazz standards, in an elegant and nostalgic setting. It's an essential experience for film buffs and jazz lovers alike, offering a timeless escape.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'As Time Goes By' cocktail, paired with their signature Filet Mignon.
picks.insiderTip: Reservations are highly recommended, especially for dinner. Arrive early to secure a good seat near the piano for the best musical experience.
picks.redditQuote: "Rick's Cafe in Casablanca is pure magic. The piano player there absolutely killed it with the jazz tunes, felt like I was in the movie. Definitely worth the hype for the atmosphere alone."

picks.name: Sky 28 (Kenzi Tower Hotel)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched on the 28th floor of the Kenzi Tower Hotel, Sky 28 offers breathtaking panoramic views of Casablanca alongside sophisticated live music. While not exclusively jazz, their resident bands frequently play jazz, blues, and lounge music, creating an upscale and vibrant atmosphere perfect for a night out.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic Old Fashioned or a local Moroccan wine, accompanied by their gourmet tapas selection.
picks.insiderTip: Dress smart-casual. Try to go just before sunset to enjoy the city transforming from daylight to a sparkling nightscape.
picks.redditQuote: "Sky 28 has incredible views and the live band was surprisingly good. They played some smooth jazz numbers that really elevated the whole experience. Pricey but worth it for a special occasion."

picks.name: Le Kimono (Hyatt Regency Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Le Kimono, located within the luxurious Hyatt Regency, offers an exquisite Japanese dining experience complemented by a chic bar lounge. While known for its sushi, the lounge frequently features live music, including jazz ensembles, creating a sophisticated and intimate ambiance. It's a fantastic spot for a refined evening.
picks.whatToOrder: Chef's selection Sushi Platter and a Sake-based cocktail.
picks.insiderTip: Beyond the dining room, the bar area is perfect for just drinks and music. Check their schedule for specific jazz nights.
picks.redditQuote: "Was at Le Kimono for dinner and the jazz trio playing in the lounge was top-notch. Made the whole experience so much more classy. Great place if you're into good food and smooth tunes."

picks.name: Le Cabestan Ocean Villa
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched on the cliffs overlooking the Atlantic, Le Cabestan Ocean Villa is synonymous with luxury and breathtaking views. Its sophisticated lounge area often hosts live music, including pianists and vocalists performing jazz and lounge classics, creating an incredibly romantic and upscale atmosphere.
picks.whatToOrder: Freshly caught seafood of the day with a glass of Moroccan white wine.
picks.insiderTip: Request a table or spot in the lounge with an ocean view. It's an ideal place for a special date or celebration.
picks.redditQuote: "The vibe at Le Cabestan is just unmatched. Sat there with a martini, listening to some chilled jazz, watching the waves crash. Felt like a movie scene. Pricey, but an incredible experience."

picks.name: CasArt Lounge (Sofitel Casablanca Tour Blanche)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located in the elegant Sofitel hotel, CasArt Lounge is a stylish haven known for its refined decor and excellent live music program. They frequently feature talented jazz vocalists and instrumentalists, offering a sophisticated backdrop for enjoying expertly crafted cocktails and small bites in a luxurious setting.
picks.whatToOrder: Their signature 'Casablanca Sling' cocktail and a platter of savory appetizers.
picks.insiderTip: The lounge can get quite busy on weekends, so arriving a bit earlier will ensure you get a comfortable seat.
picks.redditQuote: "Had a fantastic evening at CasArt Lounge. The jazz singer they had was amazing, and the cocktails were on point. It's a great spot for a relaxed but chic night out in Casablanca."

picks.name: Maison B
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Maison B is a trendy restaurant and lounge in the chic Gauthier district, known for its vibrant atmosphere and stylish clientele. While its music programming varies, it often features live bands or DJs playing lounge music with strong jazz and soulful influences, making it a lively spot for both dinner and drinks.
picks.whatToOrder: Their inventive Moroccan-fusion small plates and a 'Maison B Special' cocktail.
picks.insiderTip: The restaurant transitions into a more vibrant lounge later in the evening. It's a great place to start your night before heading elsewhere, or just stay for the music.
picks.redditQuote: "Maison B is such a cool spot. The live music wasn't strictly jazz, but it had that sophisticated lounge vibe with a lot of jazz elements, perfect for unwinding after a long day."

picks.name: La Bodega de Casablanca
picks.whyItMadeTheList: La Bodega brings a slice of Spain to Casablanca, famous for its lively atmosphere, delicious tapas, and energetic live music. While flamenco is a staple, they frequently feature bands that incorporate gypsy jazz, Latin jazz, and instrumental sets that perfectly complement the vibrant setting and Spanish wine selection.
picks.whatToOrder: A variety of authentic Spanish tapas and a pitcher of homemade Sangria.
picks.insiderTip: This place gets very crowded and loud, especially on weekends. Go for the energy and the fun, not for quiet conversation. Arrive early to grab a table.
picks.redditQuote: "La Bodega is always a blast! The live music sometimes has awesome jazz-flamenco fusion that gets everyone dancing. Best tapas in Casablanca and great vibes."

picks.name: Le Living Bar (Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Within the opulent Four Seasons, Le Living Bar offers an incredibly plush and sophisticated setting. It's renowned for its expertly crafted cocktails and a serene ambiance often enhanced by live music, including talented pianists and vocalists performing jazz and soul classics, making it a top choice for a luxurious, relaxed evening.
picks.whatToOrder: A bespoke cocktail from their skilled mixologists and the mini Wagyu sliders.
picks.insiderTip: The terrace offers stunning ocean views if the weather is good. It's a perfect spot for pre-dinner drinks.
picks.redditQuote: "The Living Bar at Four Seasons is my go-to for chill jazz nights. The pianist is phenomenal, and the cocktails are next level. Super elegant place to just unwind."

picks.name: Le Relais de Paris (Le Bistrot)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A classic French bistro in the heart of Maârif, Le Relais de Paris offers a cozy and authentic Parisian atmosphere. While primarily a restaurant, its intimate bar area and occasional live performances often feature a pianist or a small band playing French chansons, jazz standards, and lounge music, creating a charming and romantic setting.
picks.whatToOrder: Their famous 'Entrecôte' with secret sauce and a glass of Bordeaux.
picks.insiderTip: This spot is more about the cozy bistro vibe with jazz elements rather than a dedicated jazz club. Perfect for a relaxed dinner with background music.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Relais de Paris has such a charming atmosphere. The live piano player on Friday night played some lovely jazz tunes that really took me back to Paris. Great food too!"

picks.name: L'Etoile du Plazza
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled within the Idou Anfa Hotel, L'Etoile du Plazza offers a versatile dining and entertainment experience. Its spacious bar and lounge area frequently hosts live music acts, including vocalists and bands performing a mix of pop, soul, and jazz. It's a popular choice for those looking for a lively evening with diverse musical offerings.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic Mojito and their grilled chicken skewers.
picks.insiderTip: The music tends to get louder later in the evening. If you prefer a more laid-back experience, visit earlier.
picks.redditQuote: "L'Etoile du Plazza had a really good band playing. They did some jazz covers that sounded great. Good place for drinks and some dancing if you're in the mood."

picks.name: Le Loft (Odyssee Center Hotel)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Le Loft at the Odyssee Center Hotel provides a modern and comfortable setting for an evening out. Its spacious bar and lounge area is known for hosting regular live music performances, often featuring local bands that blend pop, soul, and instrumental jazz, making it a pleasant spot for unwinding with friends or colleagues.
picks.whatToOrder: A craft beer or a refreshing mocktail, paired with their crispy calamari.
picks.insiderTip: Conveniently located near Casa Port, it's a good option if you're staying in that area or arriving by train.
picks.redditQuote: "Stopped by Le Loft for a drink and they had a cool band playing covers, including some really nice jazz pieces. Chill atmosphere and good service."

picks.name: La Cascade (Hyatt Regency Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: While primarily a restaurant and cafe, La Cascade within the Hyatt Regency offers a serene and elegant lobby lounge area that occasionally features a live pianist. This often includes classical and jazz standards during evening hours, providing a sophisticated backdrop for a quiet drink or coffee, making it a refined, subtle jazz experience.
picks.whatToOrder: A gourmet coffee or a digestif, accompanied by one of their exquisite pastries.
picks.insiderTip: This is perfect for a more subdued, background jazz experience. It's less of a lively bar and more of an elegant lounge with musical accompaniment.
picks.redditQuote: "The piano player at La Cascade in the Hyatt was amazing. Just light, beautiful jazz while I had my coffee. Really relaxing and classy, a nice change of pace."

faq.question: What is the best night to experience jazz in Casablanca?
faq.answer: While some venues like Rick's Cafe offer live piano jazz nightly, many other bars feature their main jazz acts or live bands on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday evenings. Weekends are generally the best time to find the most vibrant music scenes and full bands.

faq.question: Is there a dress code for jazz bars in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Most upscale jazz bars and hotel lounges in Casablanca, such as Sky 28 or the Four Seasons' Le Living Bar, prefer smart-casual attire. For places like Rick's Cafe or Le Cabestan, it's best to dress a bit more formally. More casual spots like La Bodega have a relaxed dress code.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for jazz bars in Casablanca?
faq.answer: For popular and upscale venues like Rick's Cafe, Le Cabestan, or any hotel lounge, especially on weekend evenings, reservations are highly recommended. For smaller or more casual spots, you might be able to walk in, but it's always safer to call ahead to ensure availability and confirm live music schedules.

faq.question: Are jazz bars in Casablanca expensive?
faq.answer: Prices vary widely depending on the venue. Upscale hotel bars and fine dining lounges can be quite expensive, with cocktails often costing 100-200 MAD (~$10-20 USD). More casual spots like La Bodega offer more budget-friendly options. Factor in the cost of drinks and potentially small bites.

faq.question: Can I find traditional Moroccan music in Casablanca's jazz bars?
faq.answer: While most listed venues focus on jazz, international, or lounge music, some places like Maison B or even La Bodega might occasionally incorporate Moroccan influences or traditional instruments into their sets, especially fusion bands. However, dedicated traditional Moroccan music venues would be a separate category.

faq.question: Are there any age restrictions for Casablanca's jazz bars?
faq.answer: Yes, in Morocco, the legal drinking age is 18. Most bars and lounges will strictly enforce this, especially for evening hours. You may be asked for identification at the entrance, so it's always advisable to carry a valid ID if you look under 25.

methodology: Our selection of Casablanca's best jazz bars is based on extensive research, local recommendations, online reviews, and personal visits. We prioritized venues known for their consistent live jazz performances, exceptional ambiance, quality drinks, and overall guest experience, ensuring a diverse list for every taste and budget.
